title: Shiproom quick log — launch week prep
content:
Quick log for shiproom / launch week — working notes and immediate todo. Rough, not polished.

Date: 2026-03-13
Context: final pre-launch sprint for hosted-api v2 routing + canary. Goal today: finish PRD edits, confirm canary settings with infra, sync on rollback guards, and update release notes copy.

TODAY (top priority)
- Finish PRD section: "requirements & SLOs" (short bullets, link to benchmarks).
  - 99th pctl latency target: 350ms for 512-token requests (note: dependent on autoscale warm pools).
  - throughput: baseline 120 req/s per shard at p95 for model-x-quantized.
- Confirm canary policy with infra (Ravi) — need explicit fallback model variant and double-check cost cap.
- Smoke tests: run smoke-suite v3 against canary cluster (Sofia) — record token billing and latency breakdown.
- Update release notes draft (short + TL;DR) and one-line migration guidance for customers pinned to old model ids.

PRD edits (in-file TODOs / comments)
- Add small section: "Model fallbacks & observable signals". Call out signals: error rate > 1%, 95th latency > 2x baseline, divergence in quality evals (BLEU/ROUGE if available).
- Clarify "pinning semantics" — what happens when we auto-fallback: preserve API contract, add header x-redwood-fallback: true.
- Remove long appendix on historical benchmarks (move to /confluence/benchmarks).
- Add short runbook snippet for on-call: how to force canary to 0% (API & console steps).

STAKEHOLDER FOLLOW-UPS (who I need to ping)
- Infra: Ravi — confirm safe canary ratio and warm-pool prewarm window (expected: 5m).
- SRE: Marcus — verify alert thresholds and that traces are captured with token-level tags.
- Legal/Security: Ana (cc) — check the privacy blurb in release notes for hosted inference logs retention.
- Sales/CS: Jenna — send launch one-pager + known limitations (no private-deploy parity for 0-24h).

LAUNCH CHECKLIST (quick actionable items)
- [ ] Canary config pushed (versioned) + smoke suite run green.
- [ ] Canary traffic ramp plan in Ops channel + on-call ack.
- [ ] Release notes + migration blurb ready and uploaded to confluence page.
- [ ] Docs snippet for SDK: new param for fallback handling (js/python examples).
- [ ] Billing alert: set temporary budget cap alert for first 6 hours.
- [ ] UX banner draft for Console announcing rolling deployment.

QUICK NOTES FROM 09:30 SYNC
- Canaries start at 1% for 30m, then 5% for 2h, then 20% for 3h if no regressions. (Marcus to own alert watch during ramp.)
- If p95 > 2x baseline for two consecutive windows -> immediate rollback to previous model-v.
- Ravi: we'll reserve an extra 2 shards for warm pool for 1h following canary ramp. Confirmed.

BLOCKERS
- Need infra to expose canary rollback API key for product-runbook (security review pending). (Ana to loop back by EOD.)
- One PR in platform repo blocking docs generator: GH #621 needs a small config tweak.

NOTES TO SELF / REMINDERS
- Keep PRD language concise: execs should be able to read "what changes" in 2 mins.
- Capture a short heatmap in confluence showing latency by model variant for the last 48h (Sofia to export).
- Drop example curl commands into the runbook (include x-redwood-fallback header example).

RELEASE NOTES DRAFT (short)
- Headline: "Hosted API: safer, faster model routing"
- TL;DR: "We’re rolling out smarter routing and fallback policies to improve latency and reliability. Most customers see 15-30% cost reduction for steady-state workloads."
- Known limitations: "Some edge workloads may see initial latency variability during ramp; pinned versions will continue to be supported without automatic routing changes."

OPEN QUESTIONS (to resolve before go)
- Q1: Do we keep historical routing decisions in user-facing logs or only internal audit? (Legal input required.)
- Q2: Is the billing alert threshold per-customer or org-wide for the first 24h? (Finance owns.)
- Q3: Should we expose a public metric for canary progress in the console? (product decision, cost/ops tradeoff)

NEXT ACTIONS (my checklist, ordered)
1) Push PRD edits and ping reviewers (Ravi, Marcus) — target noon.
2) Merge GH #621 config tweak -> unblock docs generator.
3) Ask Sofia to run smoke-suite and paste results into GH issue.
4) Draft the one-pager for CS and attach to Confluence page.

RANDOM SCRATCH / short thoughts
- Consider adding a tiny "cost mode" toggle in Console for customers who prefer latency vs cost tradeoffs — low effort, big ROI for some mid-market accounts.
- Keep the fallback header visible in logs so we can run quality regressions post-rollout.

END

---
This is a working scratchpad. Will prune and move finalized pieces into Confluence / PRD doc later.
